page.notes: Right part of the page is cut off; the right-hand column of the table (e.g. "Clar...", "anno...") is only partly visible and is not transcribed beyond the cut. Some words are cut at the line ends. The Greek word "σύγχρονος" is read as printed, with doubtful letters. The bottom watermark (http://rcin.org.pl) is not printed text and is omitted. The left edge of every line is cut off, so the first words are incomplete. Some numerals are hard to read and may be misread: "3670", "292", "3680", "282", "3701", "261" are given as they appear. The "npiadum" line may be "Olympiadum" with the start cut away; the reading is uncertain.
